headline: Inland Fronts Steady While Clashes Flare Across Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Since the previous report, the frantic pace of strategic base turnover across the northern battlefields has slowed, while action has flared back to life in the western islands. Fisherman's Row registered renewed movement with three base transitions in the past two hours alongside accelerating enlistments, centered on contested works around Eidolo and Black Well. In Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse, where violent fighting previously forced rapid installations changes, no fresh base flips occurred during the last two hours; however, both sectors remain hotbeds of heavy attrition, logging over one thousand and seventeen hundred combined casualties respectively in the latest window. Mooring County continues to see accelerating casualty rates and active troop deployments despite a temporary pause in base seizures following earlier clashes at The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk. Meanwhile, Stlican Shelf, Linn of Mercy, and Palantine Berm have settled into relative lulls after brisk action earlier in the morning, with casualty tempos dropping sharply across the eastern lines.
